links.comparator_used: Baseline 'Basic Prompt' (CRISPE structured framework as a bundle vs basic prompt; components not tested separately)
links.outcome: Expert-rated 7-Dimensional Index (7DI) score for AI-generated dental EMRs
links.effect: Mean 7DI 28.86 ± 2.12 with CRISPE vs 26.91 ± 2.36 with basic prompt; p<.001, across all six models
links.quote: The CRISPE strategy significantly outperformed the basic prompt across all models (Mean 7DI: 28.86 ± 2.12 vs. 26.91 ± 2.36; p<.001).

links.comparator_used: Proprietary cloud-accessed models (GPT-4o, GPT-4, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, Grok-3) vs open-source locally deployable DeepSeek-V3 and LLaMA-3.1-405B
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3 mean 7DI 28.76 ± 2.04 vs GPT-4o 29.22 ± 2.25 (p>.05); one-way ANOVA across models F = 0.54, p=.744; authors state non-significance is not equivalence
links.tradeoff: Local deployment was not tested directly; the authors say larger prospective validation is needed.
links.quote: Under optimized prompting, DeepSeek-V3 achieved a mean 7DI score of 28.76 ± 2.04, and we did not detect statistically significant differences versus GPT-4o (29.22 ± 2.25; p>.05) in this expert-rated sample.

design_hint: structured prompt engineering (CRISPE framework) vs basic prompt; local open-source deployment
